beats.purpose: Hook: introduce the hero, the place and the problem.
First branch. Find an item that matters later.
Paths meet. The hero may go back for what was missed.
A choice that is locked without the item or clue, with a hint, plus an open alternative.
The big moment. Choices lead to different endings.
Best ending: earned with clue and item.
Gentle setback ending that invites another try.

notes: Keep sentences at or under 16 words.
Every ending must be reachable; no passage may trap the reader.
Continuity fact: Ameru is a fictional desert city, with no link to any real culture or religion
Continuity fact: The tomb has five chambers, and each has a carved warning
Continuity fact: A mummified sleeper lies in a stone box at the centre
Avoid: violence, gore or anyone being badly hurt
Avoid: real brands, companies, places or real people
Avoid: any real religion, god or sacred rite
Avoid: the sleeper is never shown harming anyone
